question: Which of the following statements is true?

options.text: Acids change the colour of red litmus to blue
Bases change the colour of the blue litmus to red

solution:
The correct answer is **__Bases are bitter in taste__. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bases can be defined as chemical compound that releases **Hydroxide Ions** when dissolved in aqueous solutions. 
 
• In other words, these are ionic compounds that dissolve in water and form Hydroxide Ions.
 
• There are 3 (three) definitions of bases in Chemistry: **Arrhenius Base, Bronsted Base, and Lewis Base.**
 
• **Examples **of Bases are Sodium Hydroxide, Potassium Hydroxide, Aluminium Hydroxide, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Slippery Substance
 
• Reacts with acids to form salt and water.
 
• Good conductor of electricity.
 
• Bitter in taste. 
 
• pH value ranges between 8-14. 
 
• Bases turn red litmus into the blue.
